products.name: Raclette de Compton au Poivre - 2024 ACS Best in Show!
products.tagline: Raw Cow - Fromagerie la Station - Quebec, Canada
products.description: Fromagerie la Station’s journey to award-winning cheesemaking began with Alfred and Aglaé Bolduc’s 1928 arrival to the town of Compton in Québec province. Four generations later, the Bolduc family is still working the same land, now making farmstead organic cheeses and harvesting maple syrup. Best in Show winner at the American Cheese Society’s 2024 competition, Raclette de Compton au Poivre has a copper-colored washed rind, a supple golden paste, and a line of pink peppercorns running through the center of the cheese. The aromas of apple, chestnut, and butter open even more when heated. Perfect for melting over boiled potatoes, crusty bread, cornichons, and cured meats!

products.name: Isle of Mull Cheddar
products.tagline: Raw Cow - Reade Family/Neal's Yard Dairy - Isle of Mull, Scotland
products.description: What happened when a couple of Somerset natives relocated to the Isle of Mull? They built a farm and the island's only creamery. After production, Isle of Mull Cheddar is aged by Neal's Yard in London for about 18 months. Depending on time of year, this farmstead cheddar can vary in color from pale yellow to bright white. Occasionally natural blue veining will occur, but don't let this deter you; consider it a tasty bonus! Complexly flavored, Isle of Mull is at once sharp, tangy, fruity and earthy.
